testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, tabs, mode switchers, modals) MUST include data-testid with kebab-case identifiers. E.g., data-testid='mode-toggle-hiring', data-testid='bottom-tab-feed', data-testid='token-wallet-card', data-testid='portfolio-card-9-16-1'
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standards: Text contrast must meet APCA/WCAG AA standards. Hover states must explicitly set text color (e.g. hover:bg-purple-700 hover:text-white).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use React JavaScript (.js / .jsx) components matching existing src/ structure.
Support Dark, Light, and System theme switching dynamically via state or next-themes/Tailwind dark class.
Implement Hiring vs Working mode toggle that updates both header context and mobile bottom navigation tabs (4 tabs per mode).
Ensure talent portfolio items strictly use 9:16 vertical video/image card ratio with overlay details.
Provide seed data for 8+ talent profiles, 6+ job listings, mock chat messages, task board columns, and token history.
Include demo data badges (DEMO DATA / SIMULATED ACTION) on simulated contact unlocks, job posts, and token purchases.
Add toast notifications using 'sonner' for actions like shortlisting, unlocking contacts, creating jobs, and switching modes.
